Dr. Maria Rodriguez

Principal Investigator

Return to archive↗

This is an inherited source-site record. Membership, biography, affiliations, and publication details have not been confirmed as BIOracle information.

Biography as supplied.

Dr. Rodriguez leads the research group with over 15 years of experience in theoretical evolutionary genetics. Her work focuses on developing predictive mathematical frameworks for biological containment systems. She received her PhD from Stanford University and has published over 60 peer-reviewed papers in evolutionary biology and mathematical modeling.

Areas of expertise

Evolutionary Genetics · Mathematical Modeling · Containment Theory

Education as supplied

  • PhD in Applied Mathematics · Stanford University · 2008
  • MSc in Mathematical Biology · University of Oxford · 2004
  • BSc in Mathematics · LMU Munich · 2002

Research interests

  • Containment expiration modeling
  • Evolutionary prediction algorithms
  • Biocontainment strategy optimization
  • Risk assessment frameworks

Publication records as supplied
